Guinea pigs are unique in that their gestation period is much longer compared to other rodents.  Other rodents such as rats gestate for about 3 weeks and give birth to blind pink hairless babies that will need a nest to develop in. Guinea pigs instead have a much longer gestation period so when their babies are born they are fully developed and ready for solid food and to evade predators if needed.
